description: Designed and deployed a full-stack Learning Management System (LMS) using Django, with integrated RESTful APIs, role-based access control (RBAC), and optimized data models to support secure, multi-user access for instructors, managers, and admins.

Engineered a scalable PostgreSQL database to migrate and modernize 30 years of bus mechanics training data from a legacy DOS-based system, eliminating over 90% of manual recordkeeping and enabling scalable cloud storage via AWS Redshift.

Built robust ETL pipelines using Python (Pandas), SQL, and Excel to extract, clean, and transform legacy data; implemented data integrity checks and schema standardization, improving validation accuracy by 95% and reducing processing time by 70%.

Developed a dynamic query interface with advanced filters for searching students, training sessions, and generating transcripts, while resolving historical input inconsistencies by replacing free-text fields with controlled dropdowns to ensure data reliability.

Integrated Power BI dashboards and embedded analytics within the web application to provide real-time reporting and visual insights, accelerating decision-making and enhancing interdepartmental collaboration across 20+ active users.

Developed and maintained responsive, SEO-optimized websites using WordPress, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, improving page load speed by 40% and maintaining 99.9% uptime; leveraged Jira and Agile workflows to deliver web updates 35% faster across the departments.

Partnered with cross-functional teams (design, video, content) to implement WCAG-compliant UI enhancements and custom plugins, resulting in a 25% user engagement boost and seamless support for high-impact campaigns across marketing and communications.

Analyzed over 5,000 content performance records, identifying trends and KPIs that improved campaign strategies and increased reach by 20%. Built 10+ interactive dashboards using Excel and Power BI, improving reporting efficiency by 35%.

Conducted A/B testing on 15+ visual content campaigns, leading to a 25% rise in engagement and a 15% boost in social shares. Automated data accuracy checks, improving dataset reliability by 30% across multimedia platforms.
Designed and implemented responsive user interfaces using React.js, HTML5, and CSS3, resulting in a 31% increase in user satisfaction and a 12% boost in audience engagement.
Developed and optimized object-oriented code in Node.js, ensuring 100% compliance with industry and company standards, which improved code maintainability and scalability by 25%.
